What We Do

Four pillars drive every project we undertake — because lasting hope is built on health, knowledge, provision and opportunity.

Youth & Sports

Who We Are

About Dynasty of Hope Foundation

A dynasty is a legacy that outlives its founders — and hope is the seed of every legacy. That is who we are.

Home › About Us
Our Story

Born in Gonigora, Raised by Community

Dynasty of Hope Foundation began in 2023 as a small circle of friends in Gonigora, Ungwan Bijeh, Kaduna, who believed that development starts from the inside out. What began as weekend visits to elderly neighbours and school-support drives for a handful of pupils has grown into a full community movement.

Today we run free medical outreach, food relief for vulnerable households, education support for primary schools, and youth sports programmes — crowned each year by our Gonigora Community Development Football Championship and Charity Carnival.

We work hand-in-hand with community leaders, schools, health workers and young volunteers, because sustainable hope is never delivered — it is built together.

What Drives Us

Mission, Vision & Values

Three compass points keep every project honest and every naira accountable.

Our Mission

To empower underserved communities in Nigeria through practical acts of service — health outreach, education support, food relief and youth development — delivered with dignity and transparency.

Our Vision

A Nigeria where every community — no matter how remote — has access to basic healthcare, quality education, food security and opportunities for its young people to thrive.

Our Values

Compassion in action. Integrity in every account. Community first. Youth as the engine of tomorrow. And faith that small, consistent gifts build a dynasty of hope.

How We Serve

Our Programmes

Every programme is community-requested, volunteer-powered and publicly accounted for.

🩺 Health Outreach

Free check-ups, BP and malaria screenings, and health talks in rural settlements around Kaduna.

📚 Education Support

Exercise books, uniforms, bags and lesson support for pupils of partner primary schools.

🍚 Food & Relief

Seasonal palliatives for widows, the elderly and families facing hardship — especially at year-end.

⚽ Youth & Sports

Community football championships and carnivals that keep young people engaged, united and celebrated.

Sponsorship Proposal

Gonigora Community Development Football Championship Tournament, Kaduna — 1st to 26th December 2026

Looking for the carnival? → Charity Carnival Blast & Mega Raffle Draw Sponsorship Proposal

1. Introduction

Dynasty of Hope Foundation cordially invites your esteemed organisation to partner with us as a sponsor of the Gonigora Community Development Football Championship Tournament, a month-long community football competition holding from 1st December to 26th December 2026 at the Gonigora Government Primary School, Ungwa Bijeh, Kaduna.

The tournament brings together youth clubs from communities across Kaduna for daily matches, drawing crowds of families, traders, community leaders and local media — and closing with an award ceremony and the Charity Carnival Blast on 27th December 2026.

2. About the Foundation

Dynasty of Hope Foundation is a Nigerian non-governmental organisation committed to community development through free health outreach, education support, food relief and youth empowerment programmes. Since 2023 we have served hundreds of families in Gonigora and neighbouring communities with the help of over 80 active volunteers.

4. Why Sponsor This Tournament

  • Massive community visibility — your brand in front of thousands of spectators across 26 match days.
  • Positive association — link your name to youth development, peace-building and community pride.
  • Media & digital reach — logo and mentions on fliers, jerseys, banners and our social media campaigns.
  • Direct engagement — brand stands, product sampling and goodwill addresses at the venue.
  • Measurable goodwill — a documented CSR story you can publish in your annual report.

Sponsorship Proposal

Charity Carnival Blast & Mega Raffle Draw — Sunday, 27th December 2026

1. Introduction

Dynasty of Hope Foundation cordially invites your organisation to partner with us as a sponsor of the Charity Carnival Blast & Mega Raffle Draw — a full day of games, music, food, family fun and big raffle prizes, holding on Sunday, 27th December 2026 at the Goni Gora Government Primary School, U/Bijeh, Kaduna.

The carnival is the grand finale of our December 2026 community programme, immediately following the Gonigora Community Development Football Championship (1–26 December). It draws the whole community together — players, families, traders, community leaders and guests — to celebrate, give and win.

2. About the Foundation

Dynasty of Hope Foundation is a Nigerian non-governmental organisation committed to community development through free health outreach, education support, food relief and youth empowerment programmes. Since 2023 we have served hundreds of families in Gonigora and neighbouring communities with the help of over 80 active volunteers.

4. Why Sponsor the Carnival

  • Festive, high-traffic audience — families and youth in a celebratory mood, perfect for brand sampling and goodwill.
  • Stage & MC visibility — your brand announced live during games, performances and every raffle draw round.
  • Print & digital reach — logo on posters, tickets, stage backdrop and our social media campaign.
  • Raffle association — sponsor a prize and your brand is literally in the winner's hands (and photos).
  • Documented CSR — a feel-good community story for your annual report and media channels.

Tracker Connection

If you ever create a new Apps Script deployment, paste its /exec URL here (this device). For all-device coverage, send the URL to be baked into the site code.

How the Tracker Works

  • Everyone who submits a form on the website is collated online in one central Google Sheet (your tracker) with status Pending.
  • You alone approve: click ✓ Approve or Reject on any record — the decision is saved to the Sheet and included in CSV exports.
  • Volunteers get notified automatically: on registration they instantly receive a “Registration RECEIVED — pending approval” email; when you approve or reject, they receive the result email — all from Dynastyofhope2023@gmail.com. The 💬 WhatsApp button opens a pre-written status message to their number.
  • This dashboard reads that Sheet live — same numbers on your phone, laptop or any device.
  • A copy of every submission is also emailed to Dynastyofhope2023@gmail.com.
  • Use the CSV buttons for Excel backups any time.
